title.en: An Act Declaring June 22 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the Municipality of Matanao, Province of Davao Del Sur, in Commemoration of Its Foundation Anniversary
title.orig: An Act Declaring June 22 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the Municipality of Matanao, Province of Davao Del Sur, in Commemoration of Its Foundation Anniversary
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 22 tháng 6 hằng năm là ngày làm việc lễ đặc biệt tại Đô thị Matanao, Tỉnh Davao Del Sur, nhân kỷ niệm Ngày Thành lập của địa phương
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 22 มิถุนายนของทุกปีเป็นวันทำงานพิเศษในเทศบาล Matanao จังหวัด Davao Del Sur เนื่องในโอกาสวันสถาปนา
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 22 Juni setiap tahun sebagai hari kerja khusus di Kotamadya Matanao, Provinsi Davao Del Sur, dalam rangka memperingati Hari Jadi
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 22 Jun setiap tahun sebagai hari bekerja khas di Perbandaran Matanao, Wilayah Davao Del Sur, sempena memperingati Hari Penubuhan

text.en: June 22 of every year is hereby declared a special working holiday in the Municipality of Matanao, Province of Davao del Sur, in commemoration of its foundation anniversary. However, upon proclamation of the President, June 22 of every year shall be a special non-working holiday in the Municipality of Matanao, Province of Davao del Sur.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
